title: 18711 - 18711/P2279/008825
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Emme Manifoldu Runner Position out of Specification
Faulty Positive Crankcase Ventilation (PCV) System or Heating Element (N79)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Emme System for Leaks
Kontrol edin:  (PCV) System and / or Heating Element if applicable
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the NAR 2.0T (BPY) Kontrol edin: RVUTB: 01-09-03  or  2018919 for updated Crankcase Breather Valve
If the breather valve is faulty, full engine vacuum is typically found when removing the oil cap at idle.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
